newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China may raise Asia Securities stake.
newsitem.headline: China may raise Asia Securities stake.

text.p: Asia Securities International Ltd said on Monday that China National Foreign Trade Transportation Corp (Sinotrans) had expressed an interest in raising its stake in the company to at least 10 percent.

"It has expressed an interest to increase its shareholding in the company up to 10 percent or above. However, there is no assurance that Sinotrans will increase its shareholding in the company," Asia Securities said in a statement.
Sinotrans, a unit of China's Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation, held close to 10 percent of Asia Securities two weeks ago, the statement said.

Asia Securities said it was also in talks with other third parties including Sinotrans regarding a proposed injection of assets into the company. It said no agreement had been reached and negotiations were still at a very preliminary stage.
Trading in Asia Securities shares was due to resume on Monday after a one-day suspension on Friday. The stock last traded at HK$5.20.
